index_metadata.description: Permanent audit trail for Botanical R&D Decision Intelligence Platform gold cases
index_metadata.purpose: Machine-readable quality monitoring and compliance tracking
index_metadata.reconciliation_note: v1.1 reconciles this index against the actual on-disk case_XXX_quality_record.json files and the actual gold_case_reference_grounded_XXX_*.py files as of 2026-08-03. Two errors from v1.0 are corrected here: (1) Case 8's domain was recorded as INDICATION_EVIDENCE, but the canonical Case 8 file (gold_case_reference_grounded_008_ginkgo_biloba_preparation_spec.py) is domain PREPARATION_SPEC — the INDICATION_EVIDENCE file is a superseded, non-canonical artifact, see 'superseded_artifacts' below. (2) Case 11's domain was recorded as SAFETY; no case_011_quality_record.json file exists on disk to support this, and the actual case file plus CASE_011_CORRECTION_REPORT.md both show Case 11 was corrected to domain INDICATION_EVIDENCE. Case 11 is therefore listed under 'known_gaps' below, not fabricated as an entry here, until a real case_011_quality_record.json is produced.

known_gaps.description: Cases with no standalone case_XXX_quality_record.json file on disk. These cases are NOT less valid than the ones above — quality-record generation was simply adopted as a standard practice starting around Case 008 and was never retroactively applied to the earlier cases. Do not infer approval_status for these from this index; consult each case file's own docstring, PROJECT_STATUS.md, and BENCHMARK_PROGRESS.md instead.
known_gaps.case_11_specific_note: case_011_quality_record.json does not exist. The v1.0 index fabricated an entry for Case 11 with domain=SAFETY, tests_passed=null-equivalent fields, and no backing file. The actual, corrected Case 11 (gold_case_reference_grounded_011_matricaria_chamomilla_indication_evidence.py) is domain INDICATION_EVIDENCE per CASE_011_CORRECTION_REPORT.md. Recommended action: generate a real case_011_quality_record.json following the same template as Cases 9/10/12, then add a proper entry here.

superseded_artifacts.description: Files that remain on disk but are no longer the canonical version of a numbered case. Per repository convention, superseded files are not deleted, only flagged. These should be added to a legacy/archival list (see .github/legacy-files.txt and repo_dependency_audit.py) rather than left ambiguously alongside the canonical file.

items.reason: CASES_008_009_010_012_CORRECTION_REPORT.md (2026-08-01): rebuilt from a non-canonical, hard-coded INDICATION_EVIDENCE draft to a canonical EMA-sourced PREPARATION_SPEC case.
items.risk: File naming makes it easy to import or reference the wrong Case 008 by mistake; both files currently coexist at repository root with no in-repo warning on the superseded file itself.
